mathematics.assertion_tested: 225 exact rational matched-clump centroid cancellation identities, two-model second-moment nonidentifiability, and a stationary blended-line false-gradient example; illustrative first-order sensitivity calculations.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact rational arithmetic for identities and blend example; IEEE binary64 for instrument-scale sensitivity illustrations.
mathematics.conventions: Sky centroid in arcsec, wavelength in nm, velocity in km/s; positive dispersion vector for increasing observed wavelength; matched same-line clumps have identical flux weights across exposures.
inputs: Toy velocities {-250,-100,0,100,250} km/s; three sky offsets and three global exposure translations; approximate vacuum Halpha/[NII] wavelengths; nominal blue dispersion and PSF in Gabarra/Fumana.
non_claims: Not a real-data velocity recovery or a0 test.
Does not establish actual exposure coverage, blending calibration or centroid errors.
Does not recover inclination, gas mass or outer flat speed.
